title: On Affording a new coat that winter
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：afford　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 afford 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the musician ① afforded a new coat that winter in silence, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② affords a new coat that winter twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ afford a new coat that winter at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ afforded a new coat that winter before — a line in the programme for December 1984 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Affording a new coat that winter in silence, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ afford the cost of a mistake twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Afford the cost of a mistake at once and never mention it again.

By 1997 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ affords the cost of a mistake in silence every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply  afforded a new coat that winter again when nobody else would.

To afford a new coat that winter, my mother said in 2002, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody affords a new coat that winter twice over again and somebody must afford a new coat that winter in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 买得起（一般过去式 afforded a new coat that winter：1990 年乐师头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 买得起（一般现在 affords a new coat that winter：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 买得起（不定式 to afford a new coat that winter：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 买得起（过去完成时 had afforded a new coat that winter：1984 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 买得起（动名词 affording a new coat that winter 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 承受得起（afford the cost of a mistake：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去承受得起一次失误的代价）
G. v. 承受得起（afford the cost of a mistake：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 买得起（后段两处：新来的听客照例 affords the cost of a mistake，而母亲又一次 afforded a new coat that winter）

answers.why: afford 意为“买得起”，1990 年乐师一言不发地买得起那年冬天的一件新外套，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 afforded。
afford 意为“买得起”，自那以后乐师来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 affords。
afford 意为“买得起”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯买得起那年冬天的一件新外套”，此处为不定式 to afford a new coat that winter。
afford 意为“买得起”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1997 年之前就有人买得起过，故用过去完成时 had afforded。
afford 意为“买得起”，乐师说“买得起那年冬天的一件新外套这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 affording a new coat that winter 作主语。
afford 意为“承受得起”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去承受得起一次失误的代价”，should ever 之后用原形 afford the cost of a mistake。
afford 意为“承受得起”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻承受得起一次失误的代价（afford the cost of a mistake at once），以后再也不要提起。
afford 意为“买得起”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例承受得起一次失误的代价，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 affords。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 afford 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the musician afforded a new coat that winter in silence, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician affords a new coat that winter twice over whenever the hall asks.
Affording a new coat that winter in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever afford the cost of a mistake twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall affords the cost of a mistake in silence every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother afforded a new coat that winter again, and the hall remembered that half.
